title: Herb salmon with new potatoes
summary: Salmon roasted with lemon and mustard, new potatoes and broccoli. A straightforward British supper with enough protein to matter.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Toss the potatoes with half the oil and half the salt and start them roasting.
Roast the potatoes until they are starting to colour. Mix the mustard, lemon juice, garlic, parsley, remaining oil and pepper.
Add the broccoli to the tin. Set the salmon on top, spoon over the mustard mixture and roast until the salmon flakes and the broccoli is tender.
steps.tip: If the broccoli is browning too fast, tuck it under the potatoes for the last few minutes.

steps.instruction: Rest for a couple of minutes and share the tin between two warm plates, spooning over the lemony juices.
